overview: Shergar: The Racehorse and the IRA is a gripping two-part docuseries telling the extraordinary story behind one of racing's most infamous mysteries. After a record-breaking Derby victory made Shergar a global sensation, armed men abducted him from a County Kildare stud farm in 1983, sparking ransom demands, political speculation, and a mystery that remains unsolved.
title: Shergar: The Racehorse and the IRA

overview: The story of Larry Goodman's rise, fall, and resurgence, revealing how he survived crises and controversy to dominate Ireland's meat industry.
title: Goodman: Too Big To Fail

overview: As an unpopular club, the Mingcheng tug of war team is led by an unreliable coach named Lei Ming, who gathers eight newcomers with various personal motives to form a team on a whim, preparing them to compete in professional competitions. They suffer a devastating defeat in their first match and are ridiculed. Thus, they start the "rise from the ashes" battle, stumbling yet growing. While gaining friendship, how will they continue to follow their original intentions and fulfill their promises to each other?
title: Let's Tug It!

overview: In the dead of winter, a mentally ill woman stops a passing vehicle to report that her husband has committed murder. Her shocking accusation leads detectives Shen Dongliang and Wu Hongbing to uncover the truth behind a series of gruesome dismemberment murders. But before the dust can settle, a string of new crimes erupts—a deadly savings bank robbery, the disappearance of a teenage girl, and a violent carjacking spree. As Shen and Wu pursue the perpetrators, they are drawn into a devastating human tragedy that will forever alter both of their lives.
title: In the Dead of Winter

overview: To help support her family, Daran gave up her dreams of higher education to start working immediately after high school. Unfortunately, she struggles to find work, eventually taking a job as a security guard at a broadcasting company. But unexpectedly, she runs into her ex-boyfriend Rangsiman, now a powerful television executive. Daran and Rangsiman were deeply in love in their teens but separated over painful misunderstandings and secrets kept from each other. Rangsiman himself is now engaged to another woman, but he finds himself drawn back to Daran, wanting to understand why she broke up with him and what led her to her current life circumstances. Can they find a way to forgive each other — and will they rekindle their old spark?
title: To Love & Cherish

overview: After losing a fellow scientist, Nik and Charles must decide how much they're willing to risk for the Lab Team of the Month title.
title: Aperture R&D

overview: A former organized crime detective and a brilliant but socially awkward psychologist team up at the newly established Crime Victim Support Office at Tokyo's Nishi-Ikebukuro Police Station. Together, they use contrasting approaches to support crime victims and bereaved families, helping them overcome their trauma and move forward in life.
title: Sayonara Noir

overview: Style Media pulls back the curtain on the sleek offices of JustFab, the fashion industry's dot-com gem, with its new docu-series "Kimora: House of Fab", which will premiere Wednesday, January 23 at 9 pm ET/PT. The hour-long series takes viewers inside the trendsetting offices of JustFab, one of the premiere online fashion membership services, advised by President and Creative Director Kimora Lee Simmons, to see just what it takes for a thriving young company to succeed. Kimora is set on leaving her mark; however, in order to move the company to the next level of fabulosity, she'll need the support of the colorful JustFab staff who rival her over-the-top personality.
title: Big Rich Atlanta

overview: Pixie and Molly are arch enemies, as different as sugar and spice. During the 1920s, they are forced to leave home to attend high school — together. They travel hundreds of miles from the tiny settlement of Coolwong, deep in the Australian outback, to a big country town — together. The girls begin a new life with a new family. Together they fight, laugh, join the Girl Guides, fly in a biplane, discover Rudolph Valentino — and together, they grow up to understand one another. A warm, humorous and exciting story of two very strong-willed girls and the development of a most unlikely friendship.
title: Sugar and Spice

overview: Ye Shishi has just accepted Yu Chengli's confession when her best friend, Jian You, claims she's back from ten years in the future. Jian You warns Ye Shishi that Yu Chengli is a scumbag and tells her to stay away from him. She also reveals that her own future husband, Jiang Hui, will kill his father on the night the college entrance exam results come out. To save Jiang Hui, Ye Shishi teams up with Jian You and Chen An, who lives next door to Ye Shishi and has secretly loved her for years. Jiang Hui himself also joins them, and the four work together to rewrite his fate.
title: Rewriting the Fate of Jiang Hui

overview: In the "Code à la Rus" project with Tatiana Morozova, our designers, together with the queen of economy renovations, Ksenia Shakhmatova, will rethink the code à la Rus in a modern style. All this is for business owners to breathe new life into their creations! 8 different establishments in the country will receive a new interior.
title: Код а‑ля Рус

overview: Where can you get a burger for a buck in the Big Apple? How about fresh oysters on the half shell at 2 a.m. in Boston? Travel guru Rachael Ray is back with insider tips and travel secrets that will turn your next vacation into a delicious, affordable feast. From the sweetest ice cream shop to the perfect spot to stage a picnic, Rachael shares tips from around the country and the world. Hop on board for some tasty travels!
title: Rachael Ray's Tasty Travels

overview: Vinny Guadagnino invites musicians, TV stars and public figures to his house to chat over his mother's meatballs in The Show with Vinny!
title: The Show with Vinny
That genius is obsessed with his fake girlfriend

overview: Singer Jin Xi makes a disastrous crossover into acting, only to be ridiculed online for his poor performance. Refusing to give up, he decides to reinvent himself by stepping into the world of musical theatre, determined to prove his critics wrong. By chance, Jin Xi falls for the cold, perfectionist musical director Ning Jin, and an unexpected kiss sparks undeniable chemistry between them. Fate brings them together again at an audition, where Ning Jin—who has little respect for idols crossing into musicals—is far from impressed. Subjecting the newcomer to relentless training and impossible standards, he pushes Jin Xi to his limits. Despite being ostracized by senior cast members, sabotaged by rivals, and scrutinized by the public, Jin Xi perseveres through grueling rehearsals, gradually shedding his idol image and discovering his true potential. His dedication slowly earns the respect of both the theatre company and the demanding director. As they face misunderstandings, career setbacks, family burdens, heartbreak, and reconciliation, the two join forces to save a struggling theatre troupe and bring a new production of A Chinese Ghost Story to the stage. Through countless challenges behind the curtains, their bond deepens, they heal one another, and together they lead the musical to a triumphant premiere.
title: As Scheduled

overview: Through exclusive behind-the-scenes access, Life In The W captures the realities of life at the highest level of women's basketball, offering viewers a front-row seat to the sacrifices, pressures, leadership responsibilities and defining moments that come with being among the game's elite athletes. Across six episodes, audiences will experience the intensity of the WNBA season from multiple perspectives: a reigning superstar continuing to elevate the game, a leader helping shape the future of the league, and a veteran icon balancing championship aspirations with a legacy already cemented among the sport's all-time greats.
title: Life In The W

overview: Set in the Taskmaster universe, the new show builds on the at-home ingenuity of earlier incarnation The Button, which Horne devised and narrated in 2018, and HomeTasking that saw Horne on a mission to entertain a world stuck in 2020's lockdown. Your Time Starts Now will see UK households compete against one another while tackling a host of his typically devious tasks without ever leaving their homes. Five teams of friends and families across the UK will need to display creativity, lateral thinking, speed, knowledge and teamwork if they want to win.
title: Your Time Starts Now

overview: DS Katie Salter is happily solving everyday crimes until fate drags her into an impossible murder mystery. Four people sat around a table seemingly set for a dinner party – except they are all dead. The only clue is a scorpion crawling out of one of the victim's mouths…
title: An Impossible Way to Die

overview: Plaifon works as a social worker for children and women. She meets a boy named Mawin. Mawin and his mother are on the run from an abusive father and hope to find shelter at the foundation where Plaifon works. When his mother suddenly dies, Mawin's world comes apart at the seams, and Plaifon is the only support in his life. Plaifon knows that love can give and take everything from a person, leaving a long trail of regret. She decides to leave Mawin to avoid the unwanted mistake. Will their paths cross again? Can they ever let go of their past?
title: Kissed by the Rain

overview: Homestead: Family Survival explores the biblical art of homesteading, farming, and holistic living.
title: Homestead Family Survival

overview: Sergey Bortnik arrives in the large provincial city under the guise of a new state fisheries inspector. In fact, he is an investigator for particularly important cases of the Investigative Committee. Here Bortnik meets his old love Liza, now the wife of the local oligarch Zbruev, a friend of his youth. But Bortnik did not come here to arrange his personal life. The Caviar Baron appeared in the city - powerful and elusive, cruel and resourceful. Together with district police officer Ivan Kashin, Bortnik is looking for the Baron - but he turns out to be too cunning.
title: Икорный барон

overview: Teen Trouble is a gripping series hosted by teen behavior specialist, author and motivational speaker Josh Shipp. In each episode, Shipp serves as the last hope for troubled families desperate to save their out-of-control teens and gives them the critical help they need to avoid tragedy. He will embed himself into the hidden lives of at-risk teens on dangerous, self-destructive paths - taking drugs, stealing from their families, abusing alcohol and breaking the law. Born an orphan and bounced around in many different foster homes until he figured out how to turn a mess into a message, Shipp has been through it all and has an unconventional method to get through to teens and their parents.
title: Teen Trouble

overview: Join two famous friends as they go head to head in a playful baking adventure, each will have to follow instructions by baker Tigga Mac and try to recreate a delicious bake inspired by Bluey. From a longdog yule log to the recreation of the Heelers' House, watch as the duo mix, decorate and mould their creations while sharing plenty of laughs along the way. Once all finished, Tigga will choose an honorary winner… but the real winner is having fun in the kitchen.
title: Bluey Cake Off

overview: Over the past two years, VOX has provided insights into the interaction and developmental stages of kindergarten children in the documentary format ‘The Mysterious World of Children'. Tom, Mert, Paulina, Abigail and the other children have now started school. They were once again accompanied by cameras for the two-part documentary ‘Wie werden groß!'. The first-graders are accompanied for one episode each in a primary school and in an adventure centre. Viewers can witness how the eleven girls and boys have developed since their kindergarten days. But not only the children, but also the parents are asked to take scientific tests - and suddenly feel reminded of their own childhood. For the first time, developmental psychologists Prof. Dr Sabina Pauen and Prof. Dr Moritz Daum also take a close look at the parents' behaviour.
title: Wir werden groß!

overview: This story focuses on China's notorious college entrance exam, the "gaokao." It follows three seniors in high school and their families as they navigate the ups and downs of their lives whilst preparing for this exam that they believe will determine the trajectory of the rest of their lives.
title: A Little Reunion

overview: ESPN Jeopardy! is the ultimate match-up between the worldwide leader in sports and the world's leading quiz show. Hosted by Emmy®-winning and Monday Night Football broadcaster Joe Buck, "ESPN Jeopardy!" features sports commentators and celebrity sports fans as they face off to experience the thrill of victory and the agony of defeat in a new arena: the Alex Trebek Stage. With material covering the full spectrum of ESPN content, this is "Jeopardy!" for sports fanatics. Contestants will represent charities of their choice as they compete in a tournament-style event for the $500,000 grand prize and the title of "ESPN Jeopardy!" champion.
title: ESPN Jeopardy!

overview: The series is set on the ultra-exclusive Jupiter Island where the privileged world of professional golfers and their wives fractures when a mysterious outsider arrives — and a secret threatens golf's reigning power couple.
title: Jupiter Island

overview: Spy School revolves around Ben Ripley, who may only be a teenager, but he's already pegged his dream job: CIA or bust. Ben is not surprised when he is recruited for a magnet school with a focus on science — but he's entirely shocked to discover that the school is a front for a CIA academy.
title: Spy School

overview: Anastasiya is a well-known family psychologist. Thanks to her work, many couples have overcome the crisis and found harmony in the family. Nastya herself has been happily married to Vladimir for fifteen years. They love each other and run a family business together.
title: Тест на верность

overview: Four ancient leaders. Two epic wars. Civilisations clash in a battle for supremacy – rewriting history forever. Fatal Conflicts: the Rise and Fall of Civilisations is a two-part documentary exploring two defining ancient rivalries: Xerxes vs Themistocles in the Second Greco-Persian War, and Hannibal vs Scipio in the Second Punic War. In each, a dominant empire, Persia or Carthage, faces a rising force, Greece or Rome.
title: Fatal Conflicts - The Rise and Fall of Civilisations

overview: Experts Sabrina Soto and Jennifer McCartney help clients develop practical, sustainable home organization methods. Their "Happy Mess Method" offers achievable solutions instead of focusing on decluttering or perfectionism.
title: The Happy Mess Method

overview: Charlie Murray is on one hell of a vacation. Financed by his aunt, Charlie plays private eye as he tracks his M.I.A. cousin Eric across six continents and multiple countries. Turns out Eric is on a quest to attend all of the world's biggest parties, and Charlie is taken along for the ride of his life. From Brussels to Bangkok, the Outback to Osaka, travel with Charlie as he is variously whipped, stripped, and double back-flipped in this outrageous globetrotting comedy, starring and directed by Neil Mandt.
title: Next Stop for Charlie

overview: Always Remember follows Pae and Liu, two successful professionals who have secretly been in a relationship for two years despite working as business rivals. Their carefully hidden romance is shattered after an accident causes Pae to lose every memory from the previous two years, including the time she fell in love with Liu. Suddenly, the woman she once loved becomes a complete stranger. To make matters even more complicated, people around Pae begin convincing her that Liu is actually her greatest enemy. Unable to reveal the truth, Liu decides to stay by her side and slowly help her rediscover the feelings they once shared. Meanwhile, an arranged marriage and escalating corporate disputes leave the couple racing against time before their future disappears completely.
title: Always Remember

overview: This magical series takes place deep in the heart of the Okavango Delta in Botswana. Isolated by the surrounding flood water, a collection of secretive and mysterious creatures are imprisoned on the paradise island of Jao.
title: The Secret Creatures of Jao

overview: The documentary series *Symbols of the Russian Navy* (produced in Russia) explores the history and key attributes of the nation's Navy, tracing its evolution from the era of Peter the Great. The series covers pivotal stages in the fleet's development, highlighting traditions, shipbuilding, and the symbols of naval power.
title: Символы русского флота

overview: The film's authors will attempt to answer the question: what was the role of the intelligentsia as a kind of spiritual and moral barometer of Russian public life, and the extent of its participation in those turbulent and fateful events during the First World War.
title: На разломе эпох

overview: From a single spark of life, through millions of generations, animals have become diverse, weird and beautiful. Chris Packham tells the incredible story in astonishing new detail.
title: Evolution

overview: Same host. Different characters. All chaos. Each week, Adam Ray taps into his roster of alter egos to interview famous guests — and no one is safe.
title: The Adam Ray Show

overview: They were more than Washington wives. They were part of an American dream known as Camelot. With strength and cunning they upheld their public image by concealing their private truths. Jackie, Ethel and Joan had little choice.
title: Jackie, Ethel, Joan: The Women of Camelot

overview: City '68 was a anthology drama set in the fictional, bustling Lancashire city of Fylde. Supposedly located on the north bank of the River Ribble—geographically nestled between Preston and Blackpool—Fylde was imagined as a massive industrial hub home to over three-quarters of a million residents. The series used this fictional backdrop as a microcosm to explore the emerging social, economic, and personal conflicts of late-1960s urban British life.
title: City '68

overview: There are no losers in the competition series Be the Boss. In each episode, two employees of a franchise-based company match skills to see who can win a promotion to senior management. At least that is the impression they're given upon being summoned to company headquarters and put through a series of challenges by their CEO. But the candidates soon discover that the winner actually receives their very own franchise, a prize that can be worth more than $1 million. The runner-up is a winner also -- he or she gets the promotion. Be the Boss is from the same creators of the Emmy-winning Undercover Boss.
title: Be the Boss

overview: Iki Kishida is a high school senior who struggles to connect with others, choosing to hide his true expressions behind a mask. Enter Harutora Kurobe, a straightforward and fiercely devoted freshman who sees right through the barriers. Despite being complete opposites, their paths cross, sparking an unlikely bond filled with the warmth, awkwardness, and heart-aching tenderness unique to adolescence. As they navigate the bittersweet waters of first love, they must confront their own vulnerabilities in a deeply moving journey of youth and self-growth.
title: Chotto Matou yo, Harutora-kun

overview: In The Secret of Secrets, symbologist Robert Langdon races against ancient forces and time to rescue his girlfriend, missing scientist Katherine Solomon, and her groundbreaking manuscript whose discoveries have the power to forever change humanity's understanding of the mind.
title: The Secret of Secrets

overview: Chen Guzhou, the legendary Tomb Leader, falls off a cliff after a deadly battle with the Corpse King of Miao Territory. Saved by the heiress of the Mechanism Clan, he hides his true identity as a servant and keeps his true power concealed—until warlords and old enemies threaten the entire clan. Forced to reveal his lost arts, Chen fights to save his people and uncover the secrets of the thousand-year-old Gu Tomb.
title: Awakening of the Tomb Leader

overview: Top influencer Gu Xiaotang's grand wedding turns into a murder scene, orchestrated by her husband, best friend, and agency. Trapped in an infinite time loop of that very day, she dies repeatedly. After several brutal cycles, she awakens and uses her curse of unlimited resets, teaming up with Dr. Ye Shen, the only one who follows her through the loops, to take revenge on her killers. Just as victory seems near, the loop resets earlier: one week before the tragedy. Gu Xiaotang realizes she must stop the source of pain before it begins and fight for a future worth living.
title: Born Again

overview: While the city is dredging a riverbed, human remains are unearthed. Medical examiner Qin Ming discovers that the victim is a woman from an old case years ago. On Qin Ming's birthday, sunspot activity causes his toy walkie-talkie to connect with his father, Qin Tian, 30 years in the past. Qin Ming warns Qin Tian about an explosion and saves him, but this triggers the Rainy Night Hammer Killer serial case. Two generations of police officers work together across time to solve the case and uncover the truth.
title: Medical Examiner Dr. Qin: Bones of the Past
Jin Wan Yue Guang Hen Mei，Cha Xiang Si Yi

overview: Set in 1920s rural Chile, the story follows José Luis Echenique, a deranged and abusive landowner who rules his estate, "La Querencia," with an iron fist. His empire of terror is threatened by the return of Manuel Pradenas, a revolutionary outsider who falls for Echenique's oppressed wife, Leonor.
title: El Señor de la Querencia

overview: The days in Querencia are about to end. The unexpected arrival of Manuel Pradenas, a revolutionary worker who returns from the north to say goodbye to his dying mother, will put in check the authoritarian hegemony of José Luis Echeñique in his traditional hacienda and in his marriage with Leonor Amenábar. Thus, the family life of the Echenique Amenábar family and his three children, Ignacio, Luis Emilio and Teresita, will change forever, collapsing the rigid values, abuses and impositions that reigned in Querencia for years.
title: El Señor de la Querencia

overview: The life of a police officer is not easy, or at least if you are Nicolás Duarte, a cunning young man who is assigned the mission of protecting Amparo Benavente, a mysterious girl who comes to visit and in passing to play revenge for the events that occurred. 8 years before the beginning of the story. But, what he doesn't know is that just 20 years before, Álvaro Grau had a relationship with his mother, but due to a dark secret they distanced themselves.
title: Témpano

overview: In this story set during the French Revolution and the Napoleonic Wars, a mysterious Hungarian nobleman, Count Vavel, rescues Marie—the heir to the executed French royal couple—from the ruthless Republican agents hunting her, and hides her in the "Castle of the Nameless," a deserted fortress by Lake Fertő.
title: A névtelen vár

overview: 15-year-old Tess Foster navigates her way through the turmoil of teen life while living at home with her single, overprotective dad and three brothers. Although Tess admires the four important men in her life, they do have four totally different perspectives. Despite the shortcomings of being the only girl in a male household, the boys can sometimes offer solid advice. Whether it's building up the courage to talk to a boy, dealing with an obnoxious one, or coping with the repercussions of being the only girl on the boys' wrestling team.
title: Life with Boys

overview: Within the Frame is a popular documentary series broadcast by Museum TV that allows viewers to explore the masterpieces and lives of history's greatest painters. It provides an inside look at renowned collections, focusing on legendary artists like Leonardo da Vinci, Rembrandt, and Claude Monet.
title: Within the Frame

overview: Icons Unearthed: Harrison Ford tells the tale of the everyman, who redefined the leading man, from a whip-cracking archaeologist to a President with a punch. This is the story of the carpenter turned actor who built an unprecedented Hollywood legacy.
title: Icons Unearthed: Harrison Ford

overview: The series follows high school student Luna Goda, who is raised as the "child of the fire god" and forbidden to fall in love. She runs a "follower business" (cult-like enterprise) at her grandmother's acupuncture clinic. When a popular classmate named Kensho rejects Luna's romantic confession, a scorned Luna plots to exact revenge by pulling him into her follower business.
title: Lunacy

overview: A 36-member cast of the world's most influential creators, including Topper Guild, Zhong, Mackenzie Turner, Matthew Beem and Jesser come together for the ultimate teen variety show.
title: Rabbit Hole

overview: Four programmes taking an in-depth look at the rise and fall of the Byzantine empire.
title: Byzantium: The Lost Empire

overview: Sword in Flames begins 7,000 years ago, focusing on a woman discovered in an ancient tomb clutching precious metal. From this starting point, the series traces the revolutionaries who figured out how to melt copper and tin to forge the very first bronze sword, following its trail from West to East across the Eurasian plains.
title: Sword in Flames

overview: Rediscovering the Arctic is an acclaimed 8-part documentary produced by CCTV. It explores the history, environment, indigenous cultures, and modern scientific expeditions of the Arctic region, detailing China's historic and ongoing relationship with the extreme north.
title: Rediscovering the Arctic

overview: Tighten your helmets and put on those extra pads because football season is about to get intense as the wives and girlfriends behind some of the sport's most elite players take the field on VH1. A flashy team of Football Wives will give viewers a never-before-seen look into the glamorous, and dramatic, life of a professional football player's spouse in VH1's original series.
title: Football Wives

overview: After joining a dating survival show, "Hot Dating Zone," at Su-a's request, Solji is assigned overwhelming physical-affection missions and gets entangled in relationships with three different guys, which turns out to be set up by Su-a to humiliate her. Now, Solji has to find a way to escape from this chaos full of betrayal and excitement.
title: Virgin Love Hell

overview: Years after a painful mistake tears them apart, a ruthless but deeply loyal lawyer and a determined female reporter are forced to work together. Bound by shared secrets and regrets, they navigate a dangerous web of revenge and healing that reignites old feelings.
title: Spread Like Wildfire

overview: Twenty-five years after the murder of Peter Falconio and Joanne Lees' escape from Bradley John Murdoch, experts uncover insights into Murdoch's motives and try to determine where Peter is buried.
title: Outback Terror: The Falconio Murder

overview: A prophecy tells that the secret name of God will be revealed with the birth of a chosen child, in the last year of the millennium.
title: Por el nombre de Dios

overview: Paura di amare centers on bereavement and a romantic new beginning: after the tragic death of his wife, pharmaceutical entrepreneur Stefano Loi plunges into despair. His life changes radically when he meets Asia, a young and determined medical student; this unexpected encounter offers both of them a second chance to find love and happiness.
title: Paura di amare

overview: The Debut: Dream Academy consists of 20 girls from all around the world on their journey to make their dream come true. As the girls go through multiple missions, they will grow and show different sides of themselves until they make it in the final debut line-up.
title: The Debut: Dream Academy

overview: In the GLAAD nominated series, It's OK to Ask Questions, NBC Chicago's Matthew Rodrigues showcases open and honest conversations with trailblazers in the queer community, offering a dialogue where no topic is off limits.
title: It's Ok to Ask Questions

overview: Gayle's a middle-aged woman, stay at home mom type who descends deeper into madness each week. She's frantic and desperate and will stop at nothing to maintain status in her community.
title: Gayle

overview: Kidnappings erupt simultaneously across seven Asian cities. Families of the victims receive a chilling email: "How far will you go to save your loved one?" Each participant is given different instructions, forced to overcome trials to rescue those they love. Seven people from diverse nationalities, backgrounds, and religions are drawn into a brutal survival contest under extreme conditions—the deadly "kiDnap GAME."
title: kiDnap GAME

overview: Gripping mystery unravelling the death of wealthy Paula Leeson.
title: The Drowning Pool: The Murder of Paula Leeson

overview: Famous actors, television presenters, bloggers and correspondents ask questions to veterans of the Great Patriotic War. Heroes will tell about the dramatic events of the past and an important contribution to the overall Victory. Veterans will also share the details, personal life and observations of their contemporaries. How did moral ideals help in shaping the generation of winners? And thanks to which the veterans managed to stay in active intellectual and physical form despite the turmoil experienced?
title: Победители

overview: A Different Breed follows 18 very talented pooches and their handlers as they compete in three annual live events, including high-flying disc routines, head-to-head weave pole racing, intricate dog agility courses and diving dog competitions.
title: A Different Breed

overview: In December 2007, a quiet Surrey town is shaken by a horrific murder. But who killed Sharon Birchwood? Detectives follow a trail to Thailand in one of the most bizarre murder cases in recent memory.
title: Murder in Suburbia

overview: With privileged access to elite clinics in London and Manchester, this series follows world-renowned doctors delivering bespoke, undetectable results for high-net-worth clients, revealing pioneering treatments and eye-watering price tags.
title: Surgery Secrets of the Super Rich

overview: 9 месяцев is a new pregnancy show that will be with you every step of the way: from the first two lines to the long-awaited meeting with your baby.
title: 9 месяцев

overview: The spring of 1945 brought the Soviet people a great victory, but World War II was not yet over. Japan continued its fierce resistance, and soon a new war—the Cold War—began. In this film, you'll see how the USSR's former allies literally transformed before our eyes into what they have now become for Russia—geopolitical adversaries. We'll take a look behind the scenes of high-stakes diplomacy and recount the Red Army's brilliant operation to defeat Japan. And we'll celebrate the 80th anniversary of the Great Victory in World War II.
title: Лето Победы

overview: Heartbreak Island's global cast jet into Fiji and sparks fly as sixteen singles pair up. Competing to be with the one they really want and $100,000 for the winning couple.
title: Heartbreak Island Australia

overview: Hosted by Gordon Robertson, brings you weekly news, devotionals, interviews, and inspiring stories from the Holy Land. Discover what God is doing through CBN Israel and hear powerful testimonies of hope, faith, and humanitarian impact.
title: The 700 Club Israel

overview: What was once a family business is now a family feud. All bets are off for what new fireworks await in American Chopper: Senior vs. Junior. Paul Senior builds world famous custom bikes at Orange County Choopers while Paul Junior operates his competing shop, Paul Jr. Designs, just a stone's throw down the road, with brother Mikey and former OCC employees firmly by his side. Will the family be made whole again? And what new out of this world build assignments will they take on to stretch their teams creatively and mechanically?
title: American Chopper: Senior vs. Junior

overview: Practicing physician, professor, author, radio show host and reality TV star "Dr. Drew" Pinsky finds time to go prime time on Headline News. The good doctor, who is an addiction specialist as well as a clinical professor of psychiatry, presents the news stories and newsmakers of the day via interviews with celebrities and other guests, focusing on the human side of the stories. He also provides his own observations and perspectives on topics that are relevant to viewers and families.
title: Dr. Drew

overview: Diego, his friends and Admiral Nemo try to save the ocean while facing great dangers.
title: 20.000 leguas de viaje submarino

overview: Stress, overwhelm, depression, anxiety, autoimmune disease, obesity, suicide, cancer, a midlife crisis, wondering what direction to take in your life? These are some of the biggest challenges of our time. What if you could have everything you ever imagined? What if the life of your dreams was already available? Come on a journey to discover the secrets to living a happy and purposeful life. Learn from the world's best on how you can achieve everything you've ever wanted, using what you already have. In this 5-part docu-series you'll hear from some of the world's most recognized doctors, high-performance athletes, thought leaders, and everyday people who are living a life on purpose through the power of food, mindset, and self-discovery. From personal stories and experiences of those who have been in the darkest trenches, have healed their trauma and recovered from great adversity to transcend the limitations in their own lives through to practical and approachable tools to apply this to your own life, find out how you can live a life beyond the ordinary. This groundbreaking new FMTV original series will inspire you to examine your own life more deeply and give you the tools to ultimately live a healthier and happier life.
title: Transcendence
Guardian: The Lonely and Great God 10th Anniversary

overview: The hosts shed light on the testimonials of various people on the experiences of supernatural help and divine interventions in their life.
title: Miracle Living Today

overview: An ordinary father in Bucharest is forced into a world he never wanted to be part of in order to save his son. But the deeper he gets, the more he realizes that the greatest danger comes from where he least expects it. A crime drama about family, sacrifice, and choices from which there is no turning back.
title: Trafic

overview: A sensitive idealist, a noble and righteous man, he dreams of a true, great love. Despite turning 40, he is still looking for 'the one'. Before fate unexpectedly turns out to be favourable, he experiences various emotional adversities. Reflective story of the unchanging human longing for goodness and honesty.
title: Jan Serce
